description: Implementation of HardwareBufferImageSiblingVkAndroid class for Vulkan on Android, managing hardware buffer images, their validation, initialization, and resource management.

classes.name: HardwareBufferImageSiblingVkAndroid
classes.description: Manages Vulkan images backed by Android hardware buffers, including validation, initialization, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: ValidateHardwareBuffer
methods.description: Validates if the hardware buffer can be used as a texture in Vulkan.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the hardware buffer image with display parameters.

methods.name: initImpl
methods.description: Performs the core initialization of the Vulkan image from the hardware buffer.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: isRenderable
methods.description: Indicates if the image can be used as a render target.

methods.name: isTexturable
methods.description: Indicates if the image can be used as a texture.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the Vulkan image helper object.
